verdict.rationale: The vendor docs and llms.txt repeatedly describe dlt as an open-source Python library, and its source is hosted in the public GitHub repository dlt-hub/dlt, so the core library's source is readable. The evidence never names the license or quotes its terms, and does not show whether the dltHub platform pieces (AI Harness, managed infrastructure, MCP server) are also open source, so coverage of the story is not complete. Missing for 10: the specific open license identified (e.g., a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier), the openness status of the dltHub platform/AI Harness components, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
